description: Cascading Style Sheets for theme management and layout styling of a tic-tac-toe web application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with centralized text and responsive layout.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Container for the game with padding and shadow styling.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styling for individual squares on the game board.

classes.name: status
classes.description: Styling for displaying the game status, includes winner indication.

classes.name: game-button
classes.description: Styling for the game buttons with hover and active effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between themes with specific positioning.
